_comment: The starter word filter. Editable in Settings; nothing here is permanent.
Scope is deliberately narrow. It covers unambiguous slurs and explicit
violent-threat language — the two categories that are the actual reported
problem in open geohash channels. It does not cover general profanity:
filtering 'damn' is theatre that makes a filter feel active while catching
nothing anybody was worried about, and it teaches people to switch the
It also makes no attempt to defeat obfuscation. Spaced letters, digit
substitutions and lookalike characters are an arms race a word list cannot
win. This catches careless abuse, which is most of it. 'Only people you
keep' is the answer to the determined, and it is the honest one.
